summary: Oconto County, WI tower at 32N-15E-11 on Chequamegon-Nicolet NF land, listed as removed or gone; no build or removal date in the sources read.

facts.status_note: Central US Lookouts lists it as Removed; the FFLA Wisconsin county list marks it Gone. No removal date found in the sources read.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only directory-level sources were found: the Central US page (Removed; no date, design or staffing), the FFLA county list (Gone, no FFLOS number) and the OpenStreetMap node (tower tags, elevation 435, no removal note). No state Architecture and History Inventory record for Archibald was searched for (search budget); the Bass Lake AHI record turned up with one search and may have an Archibald counterpart. A Wisconsin Historical Society Facebook search snippet mentions a 2015-16 restoration of an Oconto County tower and a ten-story climb to the cab; the post could not be read and the snippet does not name the tower, so it is not used here. The Nicolet forest history names the 1932 towers at Hiles, Lake Julia and Anvil Lake, not Archibald. The OpenStreetMap node is still tagged as a tower, so its map point may not match current conditions; this is not verified. Web searches used: 2. Page reads: about 6. Story is about 105 words after the 2026-10-10 check; it has no build date or site description because the sources give none, so it is shorter than the usual length. The check removed the sentence comparing the Archibald OpenStreetMap node with the Bass Lake node's removal note: the absence of a note was not in any evidence quote, and the Bass Lake node is a different tower.
